gen-dafont-groovy-gf-aldrich: Groovy leans funky, its loosely tracked c pinched almost shut. Aldrich, a plain sans with cupped round letters and tall lowercase, gives that pinched quirk somewhere open and sturdy to rest.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-comme: Friendly and a bit funky, Groovy pinches its c almost shut. Comme, in sans-serif, runs smooth with no clogged curves, so paragraphs would glide along on its large lowercase bodies.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-duru-sans: Groovy draws uninterrupted monoline strokes, with a c that nearly closes up. Duru Sans, a plain sans, keeps wide openings on small letters, and its bodies dominate each line.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans reads crisp, its lowercase e opened wide and its strokes steady. And Groovy, friendly and funky, pinches its c almost shut, giving the open sans below a lively foil.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-gafata: Groovy is friendly and funky, with arms and legs drawn at constant width. Gafata, a contemporary sans, stacks a tall band of letters with short stalks above, so long reading goes smoothly.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-geist: Geist reads quiet and level, its words landing as solid blocks. But Groovy does the lively part, funky with its nearly shut c, while Geist handles the steady part.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-golos-text: A narrow slit almost seals the c in Groovy, funky and friendly. Golos Text, a plain sans, fills each line with generous lowercase and a widely parted s, so paragraphs feel approachable.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-heebo: Groovy is friendly and funky, with strokes that never vary. Heebo, the sans-serif here, stands up tall through the middle and lets its curves stop short instead of closing in.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-hind-guntur: Loosely tracked lowercase and a nearly sealed c give Groovy its funky streak. Hind Guntur, a plain sans, steps in with wide gaps between curve ends and stems and tall, stamped-metal lowercase.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru, a plain sans, presses its lowercase tops close to the ascender height and leaves each a with its mouth ajar. Those open letters play lively against Groovy, whose c nearly closes.
